id: title:frankh:derive original expiry timestamp from timestamp in logs and traces kafka mvs

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the expiry calculation for logs34 and trace spans ingestion materialized views, using timestamp instead of observed_timestamp.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded change to the ingestion layer: replacing the timestamp column with a calculated expiry timestamp in materialized views for logs34 and trace spans.
